/-!
# Erdős Problem 113

*References:*
- [erdosproblems.com/113](https://www.erdosproblems.com/113)
- [ErSi84] Erdős, P. and Simonovits, M., *Cube-supersaturated graphs and related problems*.
  Progress in graph theory (Waterloo, Ont., 1982) (1984), 203-218.
- [Er90] Erdős, Paul, *Some of my favourite unsolved problems*. A tribute to Paul Erdős (1990),
  467-478.
- [Er91] Erdős, P., *Problems and results in combinatorial analysis and combinatorial number
  theory*. Graph theory, combinatorics, and applications, Vol. 1 (Kalamazoo, MI, 1988) (1991),
  397-406.
- [Er93] Erdős, Paul, *Some of my favorite solved and unsolved problems in graph theory*.
  Quaestiones Math. (1993), 333-350.
- [Ja23b] Janzer, Oliver, *Disproof of a conjecture of Erdős and Simonovits on the Turán number
  of graphs with minimum degree 3*. Int. Math. Res. Not. IMRN (2023), 8478--8494.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter Asymptotics SimpleGraph

namespace Erdos113

/--
If $G$ is bipartite then $\mathrm{ex}(n;G)\ll n^{3/2}$ if and only $G$ is $2$-degenerate, that
is, $G$ contains no induced subgraph with minimal degree at least 3.

Conjectured by Erdős and Simonovits [ErSi84]. Erdős first offered \$250 for a proof and \$100 for
a counterexample, but in [Er93] offered \$500 for a counterexample. Disproved by Janzer [Ja23b]
who constructed, for any $\epsilon>0$, a $3$-regular bipartite graph $H$ such that
$$\mathrm{ex}(n;H)\ll n^{\frac{4}{3}+\epsilon}.$$

See also [146](https://www.erdosproblems.com/146) and [147](https://www.erdosproblems.com/147).

The linked formal proof refutes the "only if" direction via Janzer's construction.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5, formal_proof using lean4 at
  "https://github.com/plby/lean-proofs/blob/8822f7ddef30fadbd92e1c6ab4ed897af356af5e/src/latest/ErdosProblems/Erdos113.lean#L4902"]
theorem erdos_113 : answer(False) ↔ ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), G.IsBipartite →
    (((fun n : ℕ => (extremalNumber n G : ℝ)) =O[atTop] fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ↔
      G.IsDegenerate 2) := by
  sorry

end Erdos113

reformulations.difference: The source's '2-degenerate, that is, G contains no induced subgraph with minimal degree at least 3' (Janzer: 'r-degenerate if each of its subgraphs has minimum degree at most r') is formalized as `G.IsDegenerate 2` := every nonempty `s : Finset V` contains a vertex `v` with `(s.filter (G.Adj v)).card ≤ 2`, i.e. a universal 'there is a low-degree vertex' form rather than a 'no min-degree-≥3 induced subgraph' form. The claim is also packaged as `answer(False) ↔ ∀ ...`, i.e. `¬ conjecture`.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Negating `IsDegenerate 2` gives a nonempty vertex set s in which every vertex has at least 3 neighbours inside s, i.e. a nonempty induced subgraph G[s] of minimum degree at least 3; so the two are negations of each other's negation. A non-induced subgraph with minimum degree at least 3 on vertex set s yields G[s] with minimum degree at least 3 (neighbourhoods only grow), so Janzer's all-subgraphs definition coincides as well. Both equivalences were proved in Lean (scratch4.lean). `False ↔ P` is `¬P`, which is exactly 'the conjecture is false', the source's DISPROVED status.

review.notes:
No findings. What I checked:
(1) The statement elaborates to `False ↔ ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), G.IsBipartite → ((fun n => (extremalNumber n G : ℝ)) =O[atTop] fun n => (n:ℝ)^(3/2 : ℝ)) ↔ G.IsDegenerate (2 : ℕ))`. The exponent is the real 3/2, confirmed with pp.numericTypes.
(2) `extremalNumber` is the standard Turán number (supremum over H-free graphs on Fin n; containment is a non-induced copy, i.e. an injective homomorphism). `IsBipartite` is `Colorable 2`.
(3) Edge cases: edgeless graphs, the empty vertex type and K₂ satisfy both sides of the iff (checked in Lean). Isolated vertices change neither side for large n. `Fintype V` is present; without it an infinite edgeless graph would make the claim trivially false. Restricting to `V : Type` is harmless. Neither direction of the iff has a trivial counterexample.
(4) Formal-proof record: the plby/lean-proofs file proves `¬ ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] H, H.IsBipartite → (HasThreeHalvesExtremalBound H ↔ IsTwoDegenerate H)`. Its big-O bound is the same expression, and its `IsTwoDegenerate` (over `Set V` with `ncard`) is equivalent to `IsDegenerate 2`. I proved in Lean that the FC statement ↔ ¬ErdosSimonovitsConjecture from that file (scratch3.lean compiles). The proof refutes the 'only if' direction with Janzer's H_{7,784}, exponent 31/21 < 3/2, as the docstring says.
(5) Status: `research solved` with `answer(False)` matches erdosproblems.com ('DISPROVED (LEAN)') and the teorth data file.
(6) The docstring's prose matches the erdosproblems page word for word, including the missing 'if' in 'if and only G is 2-degenerate' and the prize history ($250/$100, then $500 in [Er93], also corroborated by the Chung–Graham page and Janzer). I did not report the typo.
Caveat: I could not retrieve the page's LaTeX source (Cloudflare, then proxy rate limits). The formulas were confirmed through Janzer's arXiv LaTeX and the Chung–Graham page instead.
